name: Lophostropheus
sum: Coelophysoid from the Triassic–Jurassic boundary of Normandy, one of few dinosaurs that may have crossed the extinction.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Remains from the Airel locality in Normandy.
author: Ezcurra and Cuny 2007

sources.text: Ezcurra, Martin D. 2007. The coelophysoid ''Lophostropheus airelensis'', gen. nov.: a review of the systematics of "Liliensternus" ''airelensis'' from the Triassic-Jurassic boundary outcrops of Normandy (France). Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 27(1): 73–86. doi:10.1671/0272-4634(2007)27[73:TCLAGN]2.0.CO;2

Cuny, Gilles 1993. Revision of the Airel theropod dinosaur from the Triassic-Jurassic boundary (Normandy, France). Neues Jahrbuch für Geologie und Paläontologie, Abhandlungen 187(3): 261–288. doi:10.1127/njgpa/187/1993/261
Rauhut, Oliver W.M. 2002. A review of European Triassic theropods. Gaia 15: 75–88.
